item.title: Five oil tankers ablaze after striking mines in Hormuz, Iran says
item.description: Crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz fell to half prewar levels, Kpler data show, as the Iran war disrupts oil trade.

item.title: 'Groundbreaking' Trump-Xi-Putin summit in Shenzhen: five takeaways
item.description: Xi, Trump and Putin issued a peace declaration on nuclear risks, UN reform and refined petroleum supply at the APEC summit.

item.title: Russia's demands come from a different reality as war effort stagnates
item.description: At Abu Dhabi talks Russia refused territorial exchanges with Ukraine while Ukraine struck refineries inside Russia.

item.title: Pew Research: Islam on track to become world's largest religion by 2035
item.description: Pew projects 2.57 billion Muslims and 2.52 billion Christians by 2035, driven by fertility rates.

item.title: Anthropic starts trading in the US after blockbuster IPO
item.description: Anthropic's $81bn IPO on the Nasdaq surpasses SpaceX as the largest in history, amid the resignation of Nvidia's Jensen Huang.
